verdict.rationale: An in-browser site toolbar is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, since comparable hosting platforms could ship one, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a toolbar for leaving feedback, managing feature flags, or inspecting performance on a live site. Render's infrastructure metrics dashboard and its preview environments are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
